About The Role

As our People Business Partner for GoTo Group Tech team, you’ll be a seasoned and strategic People and Culture (PAC) thought partner to a specific set of our amazing Technology team. You will trade between business imperatives and the needs of our employees, contributing hands-on efforts at the strategic level partnership with relevant client-groups. You will get ample opportunity to work on a variety of global projects, acting as a thought-leader by sharing our knowledge, experience and people-related best practices among the broader PAC team and GoTo ecosystem.

What You Will Do

• Supports and contributes to strategic conversations with senior leadership, both within and outside his/her respective business
• Leads and implements people and talent strategies for respective businesses (succession planning, talent management etc.)
• Participate in the evaluation of strategies (e.g. determining strategic success, diagnosing failures, strategic adjustments)
• Understands the business needs in the short, medium and long term and proactively suggests and leads initiatives and projects to solve strategic people and organizational challenges for his/her respective business
• Ensures that PAC and business solutions are on-time, on-budget, and to a high standard of quality
• Implements and advocates for programs, policies, and procedures to support the organizational culture
• Coaches, mentors, conducts career conversations and able to provide objective and actionable feedback to team members, peers and other stakeholders
• Navigates stakeholder relationship challenges well (e.g. reconciles, anticipates needs and wants, balances long and short term relationship trade offs) and comes up with solutions as appropriate
• Recognizes and takes appropriate action to mitigate risk (organizational, legal, employee relations, etc) and develops options to mitigate them

What You Will Need

• Experienced HR professional who supports overall people and organizational activities across the employee life cycle. Able to handle a big business unit independently and users up to executive level with minimal intervention from his/her manager.
• Experienced professional who supports overall people and organizational activities across the employee life cycle. Able to handle a big business unit independently and users up to L8 with minimal intervention from his/her manager.
• Typically handles a business regionally with typical years of PBP experience: 3-6 years
• Demonstrates relevant experience (business partnering, OD, performance management, talent development, C&B, ER) and ability to consult the business and leaders on how to manage people and organizational matters
• Understands the right levers to pull in a situation (comp, process, comp, training, etc.)
• Demonstrates fluency in data concepts and processes (understand stats, hypothesis-driven approach, etc) and ability to conduct data manipulation (e.g. pivot tables, charts, etc.)

About The Team

Fasten your helmet and climb aboard if you’re ready to be our People Business Partner. In this role, you will be an integral player within the PAC team. This role will collaborate closely with business leaders to develop and implement HR strategies that align with our organizational goals. Ensure compliance with all legal and regulatory requirements, and maintain up-to-date knowledge of HR best practices and industry trends. Drive initiatives that foster a positive and inclusive workplace culture. Champion diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives, fostering an environment where all employees feel valued and respected. Provide expert HR guidance on a variety of topics, including performance management, employee relations, and talent development.

About GoTo Group
GoTo is the largest digital ecosystem in Indonesia. GoTo's mission is to 'empower progress' by offering technology infrastructure and solutions that help everyone to access and thrive in the digital economy.
The GoTo ecosystem provides a wide range of services, including mobility, delivery, payments, financial services, and technology solutions for merchants. The ecosystem also provides e-commerce services through Tokopedia and banking services through its partnership with Bank Jago.

About Gojek
Gojek is Southeast Asia’s leading on-demand platform and pioneer of the multi-service ecosystem with over 2.5 million driver partners across the regions offering a wide range of services such as transportation, food delivery, logistics and more. With its mission to create impact at scale, Gojek is committed to resolving consumer problems and raising standards of living by connecting consumers to the best providers of goods and services in the market.

About GoTo Financial
GoTo Financial accelerates financial inclusion through its leading financial services and merchants solutions. Its consumer services include GoPay and GoPayLater and serve businesses of all sizes through Midtrans, Moka, GoBiz Plus, GoBiz, and Selly. With its trusted and inclusive ecosystem of products, GoTo Financial is open to new growth opportunities and aims to empower everyone to Make It Happen, Make It Together, Make It Last.

Responsible for managing and growing relationships with key clients, achieving sales targets, and ensuring customer satisfaction within PT Japfa Food Indonesia.

Job Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute strategic account plans to achieve sales targets and expand product penetration within assigned key accounts.
* Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers at client organizations.
* Identify new business opportunities and effectively upsell/cross-sell PT Japfa Food Indonesia's product portfolio.
* Negotiate contracts, pricing, and terms of sales to maximize profitability while meeting customer needs.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to identify opportunities and threats.
* Prepare and present regular sales forecasts, performance reports, and account reviews to management.
* Collaborate closely with internal teams, including marketing, logistics, and product development, to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Resolve customer issues and complaints promptly and effectively to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction.

Job Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
* Minimum of 3 years of proven experience in key account management or B2B sales, preferably within the food industry.
* Demonstrated ability to meet and exceed sales targets.
* Strong negotiation and presentation skills.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Fluency in Bahasa Indonesia and English.



Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan

• Menyusun dan menjalankan strategi pengelolaan akun (account plan) untuk mencapai target penjualan dan meningkatkan penetrasi produk pada akun-akun utama yang menjadi tanggung jawabnya.
• Membangun dan memelihara hubungan yang kuat, berkelanjutan, dan jangka panjang dengan para pemangku kepentingan serta pengambil keputusan di organisasi pelanggan.
• Mengidentifikasi peluang bisnis baru serta secara efektif melakukan upselling dan cross-selling terhadap portofolio produk PT Japfa Food Indonesia.
• Melakukan negosiasi kontrak, harga, dan syarat penjualan untuk memaksimalkan profitabilitas sekaligus memenuhi kebutuhan pelanggan.
• Memantau tren pasar, aktivitas kompetitor, dan umpan balik pelanggan untuk mengidentifikasi peluang maupun potensi ancaman bisnis.
• Menyusun dan menyajikan proyeksi penjualan, laporan kinerja, serta tinjauan akun secara berkala kepada manajemen.
• Bekerja sama secara erat dengan tim internal, termasuk pemasaran, logistik, dan pengembangan produk, untuk memastikan pelayanan yang lancar dan optimal kepada pelanggan.
• Menangani serta menyelesaikan masalah dan keluhan pelanggan dengan cepat dan efektif guna menjaga tingkat kepuasan pelanggan yang tinggi.

Kualifikasi Pekerjaan

• Pendidikan minimal Sarjana (S1) di bidang Administrasi Bisnis, Pemasaran, atau bidang terkait.
• Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun yang terbukti dalam pengelolaan key account atau penjualan B2B, diutamakan dari industri makanan.
• Memiliki kemampuan yang terbukti dalam mencapai dan melampaui target penjualan.
• Memiliki keterampilan negosiasi dan presentasi yang sangat baik.
• Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, interpersonal, dan membangun hubungan yang kuat.
• Mampu mengoperasikan Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, dan PowerPoint) dengan baik.
• Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim.
• Memiliki kemampuan analitis dan pemecahan masalah yang kuat.
• Fasih berbahasa Indonesia dan Inggris, baik lisan maupun tulisan

Job Summary**

Responsible for coordinating and overseeing warehouse operations at our RPU Megaluh facility to ensure efficient receipt, storage, and dispatch of goods, maintaining inventory accuracy, and supporting overall supply chain objectives.

Job Responsibilities**

* Supervise and train warehouse staff on best practices for receiving, storing, picking, and shipping products.
* Manage daily warehouse activities, including inbound and outbound logistics, material handling, and inventory control.
* Ensure accurate record-keeping of all inventory movements using warehouse management systems (WMS).
* Conduct regular cycle counts and physical inventories to reconcile discrepancies and maintain inventory accuracy.
* Optimize warehouse layout and space utilization to maximize efficiency and storage capacity.
* Implement and enforce safety procedures and compliance with company policies and regulations.
* Coordinate with procurement, production, and logistics teams to ensure timely delivery of materials and finished goods.
* Identify and resolve operational issues, such as shipping delays, inventory shortages, or damaged goods.
* Prepare reports on warehouse performance, including inventory levels, productivity, and shipping accuracy.
* Operate and maintain warehouse equipment, such as forklifts and pallet jacks, safely and effectively.

Job Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent; a bachelor's degree in logistics, supply chain management, or a related field is a plus.
* Minimum of 2-3 years of experience in warehouse operations, inventory management, or a similar role.
* Proven experience in a supervisory or coordinator role.
* Proficiency in using Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word).
* Strong understanding of inventory control principles and warehouse best practices.
* Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Valid forklift operator certification is preferred.
* Willingness to work flexible hours, including weekends or holidays, as needed.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Supervise the daily activities of the finance and accounting team to ensure accurate and timely financial reporting.
- Ensure the effective execution of finance and accounting plans and strategies.
- Resolve escalated financial and accounting issues promptly and efficiently.
- Prepare and present performance reports to senior management, highlighting key metrics and areas for improvement.
- Ensure compliance with finance and accounting standards and regulations.
- Assist in the preparation of financial reports, budgets, and forecasts.
- Provide guidance and support to finance and accounting staff to enhance their skills and performance.
- Coordinate with other departments to ensure efficient financial operations.
- Implement continuous improvement practices to enhance finance and accounting processes.

- Mengawasi aktivitas harian tim keuangan dan akuntansi untuk memastikan pelaporan keuangan yang akurat dan tepat waktu.
- Memastikan pelaksanaan rencana dan strategi keuangan dan akuntansi yang efektif.
- Menyelesaikan masalah keuangan dan akuntansi yang dieskalasi dengan cepat dan efisien.
- Menyiapkan dan menyajikan laporan kinerja kepada manajemen senior, menyoroti metrik utama dan area yang perlu diperbaiki.
- Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap standar dan regulasi keuangan dan akuntansi.
- Membantu dalam persiapan laporan keuangan, anggaran, dan perkiraan.
- Memberikan panduan dan dukungan kepada staf keuangan dan akuntansi untuk meningkatkan keterampilan dan kinerja mereka.
- Berkoordinasi dengan departemen lain untuk memastikan operasi keuangan yang efisien.
- Menerapkan praktik perbaikan berkelanjutan untuk meningkatkan proses keuangan dan akuntansi.
